doc.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Kenny Burrell at Yoshi's and the end of the discography
summary: Brown covers Kenny Burrell's Yoshi's recording and the discography ends in 2008. Laws warns that he cannot remember everything.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: So I’m looking. You mentioned Eugene Maslov. I’m going to just keep moving on that one. Then Kenny Burrell is listed on here. That was with his trio, Robert Miranda and Clayton Cameron, Live at Yoshi’s.
So that was the old Yoshi’s. That’s the Oakland Yoshi’s.

Yeah, that’s the one in Oakland, and also we recorded up at UCLA. We did something over there. I don’t know if they put – it’s a live orchestra and all that. I don’t know if they’ve released that, but we recorded that as well.
That exhausts my discographical references, because this only goes up to 2008. Are you any projects that you want to make sure . . . ?

You can’t depend on me. You really can’t depend on me, because I can’t remember everything. I know I’ve done some other things too. Luba Mason, for instance. I told you that I did with her, and then we went to Panama after that. Yeah, I’ve done some other things.
